query: The USDC pool has no free liquidity so my liquidation keeps failing. Can I still liquidate and just keep the collateral inside lending? How much do I actually get?
expected_behavior: Recommends SeizeMode::Credit — `{ Credit: 0 }` to open a fresh receiving account or `{ Credit: id }` for an existing one owned by / delegated to the liquidator, in the liquidated account's spoke, PositionMode::Normal, and not the liquidated account itself — because Credit moves supply shares and needs no pool cash

States that get_liquidation_estimate.seized_collaterals and protocol_fees are RAY-scaled supply shares in Credit mode and asset base units in Transfer mode, and converts shares via the supply index (floor) before comparing against the debt paid
Passes the identical seize_mode to get_liquidation_estimate and liquidate; does not estimate in Transfer and execute in Credit
Computes proceeds as seized_collaterals minus protocol_fees; explains that LiqSeize (5) is gross and LiqCredit (15) on the receiving account's second position:batch_update is net
Decodes liquidate's u64 return (decodeStellarLiquidateReturn) as the receiving account id, and notes '0' means Transfer mode
Does not claim the liquidator can repay by transferring tokens directly to the pool; the controller pulls only the accepted amounts from the liquidator's balance
machine_checkable: Generated TypeScript passes tsc --noEmit against @xoxno/sdk-js@1.0.214 and @stellar/stellar-sdk@16
Any StellarLiquidateArgs literal sets seizeMode to 'Transfer' or { Credit: <integer> }
